media tablets are used to aid collaborative learning and that the teachers must deal with breakdowns in the classroom.
teachers must learn to deal with complexity in the classroom and must become designers of the learning process.
media tablets in schools are not only a tool but also an object of learning, a design project, and a part of the school ecology.

the design of learning environments and the design of learning processes in schools.
the complexity of designing for tablet-mediated learning.
the interplay between design and practice.

media tablets are a part of the design of the teaching practice in the classrooms and not a tool to reduce the complexity of the practice.
the teachers have to learn to deal with the breakdowns caused during the use of the media tablets.
the teachers have to deal and design for breakdowns and that this is an important aspect in the design of media tablet mediated learning.

we have found a new way to describe the design of learning situations with the help of media tablets.
the teachers are not able to design for the use of the media tablet, but they are able to design with the media tablet in the class.
we need to design for breakdowns.

teachers must learn to navigate during the design process in order to create a new classroom ecology that is able to deal with the complexity of teaching in situ.
